exposure: demographic characteristics of infants with UTI
clinical characteristics of infants with UTI
microbiological characteristics of infants with UTI
outcome: clinical manifestations of UTI (jaundice, restlessness, fever)
cohort: The study included 232 infants aged less than 1 month with proven UTI admitted to three major teaching hospitals.
finding: The most common pathogen isolated was E. coli (78.4%), and the main presenting clinical manifestations were jaundice (54.7%), restlessness (45.6%), and fever (40%).
cross-section timing: Data was collected for the period 2010-2018.
